controls.name: inputAlignDelay
controls.doc: The input alignment delay travel: how far one microphone is pushed back to meet another on the same source. Not the FX delay (FX_DELAY_TIME_RANGE, a musical echo) and not the output delay (OUTPUT_DELAY_RANGE, a loudspeaker zone). max is the alignment ring's ceiling, the same number as OMX_ALIGN_MAX_MS in omx-dsp's omx_align.h: 100 ms is 34 m of air, further apart than two microphones on one source can be. The step is fine enough to carry what the fractional read applies: 0.0001 ms is under a hundredth of a sample at 96 kHz.
